## Telomir Pharmaceuticals Announces Telomir-1 Significantly Reduced Tumor Growth and Metastases in Aggressive Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Animal Models


In a TNBC animal model with limited responsiveness to chemotherapy, Telomir-1 demonstrated statistically significant activity on both tumor growth and cancer cell spread.
